description: This file defines a database migration class for version 4.0 of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods to create a new table for employee events, and to insert new menu and screen entries related to OAuth client registration within the system's admin interface.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: The Migration class handles database schema updates for version 4.0, including creating a new employee_event table and adding OAuth client registration options in the menu.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps: creating a new table if it doesn't exist, and inserting menu and screen entries for OAuth client registration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the migration, which is '4.0'.
